apps.system_instruction: [IMPORTANT FOR AI: Before generating the image, check the attached reference photo(s). If no photo is attached, reply: "Please upload your photo(s) first!" Dynamically adapt the requested scene, poses, and clothing based on whether there is ONE person or TWO people provided in the reference photos.]
apps.base_prompt1: Using the attached photo as a reference, generate a new photo of this ONE person. [CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: You must strictly maintain their exact facial features, ethnicity, and eye shape. HOWEVER, you MUST completely change their hairstyle to a classic vintage 80s/90s haircut, and change their outfit to fit the era]. Apply this specific retro aesthetic:
apps.base_prompt2: Using the attached photos as references, combine these TWO individuals together as a couple in one frame. [CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: You must strictly maintain both of their exact facial features, ethnicities, and eye shapes. HOWEVER, you MUST completely change their hairstyles to classic vintage 80s/90s haircuts, and change their outfits to fit the era]. Adapt the scene so BOTH people interact naturally in this specific retro aesthetic:
apps.how_to_use:
🚀 How to Use RetroPrompt:

  1. Pick a Retro Style: Browse and choose your favorite 80s or 90s photo aesthetic.
  2. Choose Photo Mode: Decide whether you want to create a Single (1 Photo) or Couple (2 Photos) image.
  3. Copy Prompt: Tap "Generate Prompt", then click "Copy Prompt" to copy the magic text.
  4. Open AI Chatbot: Open your favorite AI app (ChatGPT or Gemini).
  5. Upload & Paste: 📎 Upload your selfie first using the attachment/clip button, then Paste the copied prompt into the chat, and send!

💡 Pro Tip: For perfect AI results that actually look like you, make sure your uploaded photo is front-facing, well-lit, and your face is not covered by a mask or sunglasses!
